blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Immigration deported on Friday 115 Chinese involved in illegal Philippine Offshore Gaming Operation (Pogo) hubs in Zamboanga Sibugay and Quezon City. Of the 115 apprehended, 62 were arrested in the Zamboanga Sibugay hub, while 53 were nabbed in Cubao. “The Bureau of Immigration (BI) is currently deporting 115 Chinese nationals arrested during two major anti-illegal POGO operations in Zamboanga Sibugay and Cubao, Quezon City, in October,” the BI said in a text message.
